insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 47% women's / 35% men's. Alo skews 31% women's, Gymshark 20% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (13%) is NaN% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (180) vs Lululemon (205). Gap of 25 to close.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 43% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1796 vs 1286 products. A 40% advantage.
Vuori ranks #2 in shorts with 866 products. Behind Gymshark (1800).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 715 products vs Lululemon's 680. Key for cooler weather expansion.
Market context: 48,488 competitor products tracked. Vuori's 5,144 = 10% share of tracked catalog.
